Summary Description: Shane Connelly is an organizational psychologist and methodologist at the University of Oklahoma, specializing in leadership dynamics, public health communication, and labor economics. His research bridges individual traits and macro-level societal challenges, from predicting leader emergence in small groups to analyzing pandemic-era labor market resilience. Connelly employs rigorous mixed-methods approaches, including leaderless group discussions, longitudinal surveys, and advanced econometric controls, to address complex issues like vaccine hesitancy and remote work feasibility. A staunch advocate for open science, he integrates replication studies and Registered Reports to enhance scientific credibility. His work synthesizes psychological theory with robust statistical modeling to inform organizational practices, public health interventions, and economic policy.
